_comment: The .idh cutover's classification of the checkout (ticket 0985; run by `idh relocate harness`, adapters/cutover.py). Names are relative to HOME (`native_root`, `checkout`) or to the checkout's top level (the lists; `*` globs allowed). Every top-level entry of the checkout must be tracked by git, listed in `keep`, or listed in `native`; anything else is refused before the first mutation, so an unclassified file never moves by guess. `keep` stays with the checkout because the harness addresses it repo-relative or through ~/.idh (.env is UV_ENV_FILE's ~/.idh/.env). `native` is Claude Code's own state, or a file a script addresses under the native root: it moves to the new real native root. `projects` is mixed and split one level down: projects/<slug>/memory stays tracked in the checkout and is linked back; every other child moves. `claude_links` are the harness entries Claude Code reads from its native root, linked there one by one (CLAUDE.md imports RTK.md and tickets/AGENTS.md by relative path). `timers` are the user timers paused for the window when active.
